# What proves Cookie booted. One definition, used by every run that boots it.
#
# Before this file the list was written three times in m7-kernel.yml: 33 markers
# for the EL1 entry run, 13 for the EL2 entry run, 9 for the relocated run. So
# the EL2 path - the one phone bootloaders actually use, per
# docs/M7_13_HARDWARE_NEUTRALITY.md - was verified against under half the proofs
# the EL1 path was, and a regression reachable only from an EL2 handoff in any of
# the twenty-one unlisted subsystems would have passed.
#
# That subset is exactly what the EL2 work said must not happen: its own note
# records gating "the same milestone set as the EL1 run - a subset would let the
# drop silently cost a subsystem". The intent was written down and the
# implementation was the subset it warned about, which is this project's
# recurring shape: a rule recorded, and the mechanism that breaks it left in
# place.
#
# Markers whose presence depends on the CPU rather than on the code are not
# listed here - PAN is the only one, and check-boot-markers.sh takes it as a flag
# because `cortex-a72` lacks FEAT_PAN and `-cpu max` has it. A difference that
# real belongs in an argument, not in a silently shorter list.
COOKIE:M7.5d:MMU
COOKIE:M7.5d:GUARDED
COOKIE:M7.5f:EL0_SVC_RETURN
COOKIE:M7.5g:GICV3
COOKIE:M7.5g:TIMER_IRQ
COOKIE:M7.5g:TIMER_IRQ_RETURN
COOKIE:M7.5i:CONTENTION_ARMED
COOKIE:M7.5i:A_TO_B
COOKIE:M7.5i:B_TO_A
COOKIE:M7.5i:ISOLATED_A_B_A
COOKIE:M7.6:IPC_RECEIVER_FIRST
COOKIE:M7.6:IPC_REQUEST_B
COOKIE:M7.6:IPC_A_B_REPLY
COOKIE:M7.9:ATTACHED
COOKIE:M7.9:DISPATCHED
COOKIE:M7.9:SERVICED
COOKIE:M7.9:COMPLETED
COOKIE:M7.11:SPACE_CREATED
COOKIE:M7.11:SPACE_MAPPED
COOKIE:M7.11:SPACE_DESTROYED
COOKIE:M7.11:PAGES_ZEROED
COOKIE:M7.11:STALE_REFUSED
COOKIE:M7.11:EL0_CREATED
COOKIE:M7.11:EL0_DESTROYED
COOKIE:M7.11:EL0_GRANT_REUSED
COOKIE:M7.11:FAULT_REGION
COOKIE:M7.11:FAULT_ASKED
COOKIE:M7.11:PAGER_BACKED
COOKIE:M7.11:FAULT_RESUMED
COOKIE:M7.12:THREAD_ADMITTED
COOKIE:M7.12:THREAD_WOKEN
COOKIE:M7.12:PROCESS_RAN
